description: Write or close out DeerDawn memory through one tool. Update the brief, import local context, record paths or findings, upsert entities, confirm or resolve stored knowledge, finish the current task, or move a project between machines as a Trail archive (export_trail writes a private .dawn file — pass kind:"pack" when it is knowledge for other people's projects; import_trail merges one in, from a URL, a path or raw contents, without overwriting existing context). Some actions overwrite fields or permanently clear finished task state. Exported Trails are unscanned and private — this tool cannot publish one.

action.description: resolve closes a stored workspace entity; resolve_question answers ONE open question in the brief and leaves the rest of it alone.

answer.description: For resolve_question: what the question was decided to be. Recorded as a decision.

kind.description: For export_trail: 'pack' marks the Trail as curated knowledge meant for OTHER projects, so importing it skips this project's task state, goals and board. Default 'project'.

output_path.description: For export_trail: where to write the .dawn file. Defaults to the project root.

project_id.description: Project id or exact name. Omit to use the active project. The one exception is action="export_trail", which needs it explicitly and will not guess which project to archive.

question.description: For resolve_question: the exact, complete open question from the brief. A query matching several resolves none and lists them.

task.description: For update: set the brief's current task directly. Extraction cannot change this field, so pass it explicitly whenever the headline of the brief should change.

trail.description: For import_trail: an https URL to a .dawn file, a path to one, or the file contents.

name: manage_memory
